summary: Iteration 53 — Enterprise (firm) signup at /signup/enterprise. Wrote 13 backend regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_enterprise_signup.py — all 13 pass. Regression: iter49+50+51+52 → 80/80 still pass, no regressions. Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright: /signup/enterprise loads with 'Start your firm on SmartBooks' header + indigo Building2 icon, data-testid='signup-firm' input with placeholder 'e.g. PriyaBooks, LLC' between name & email, indigo 'Start my firm' button, cross-links to /signup + /signup/affiliate at bottom. Full signup with role=pro + enterprise_name='CaseyCPA UI, LLC' → lands on /pro/clients with PRO badge bottom-left, full firm sidebar (Clients/Dashboard/Invoices/Bills/Payments/etc.), and top-right AI panel labeled 'CaseyCPA UI, LLC Assistant'. Empty firm submit blocked with 'Firm / enterprise name is required'. Login page has 3 stacked signup CTAs — 'Create one' (client), 'Start on the enterprise plan' (indigo, data-testid=signup-enterprise-link), 'Become an affiliate' (data-testid=signup-affiliate-link). Backend covers: (a) SignupIn model accepts optional enterprise_name; (b) POST /api/auth/signup role='pro'+enterprise_name → user.branding.firm_name stamped, enterprise_id set, matching enterprises row with name=firm, owner_user_id=uid, slug='caseycpa-llc*', is_default=false; (c) role='pro' WITHOUT enterprise_name is backwards compatible (no enterprise, no comm row); (d) role='client'+enterprise_name is ignored (no enterprise, no comm); (e) email_templates.enterprise_welcome exact subject, name in salutation, enterprise_name, all 3 CTA hrefs (dashboard/invite/billing), slug 'reserved firm handle' block present or omitted per slug None, 'Sent by {enterprise_name}' footer with NO smartbookssoftware.ai within 200 chars (private-label); (f) DEFAULT_PREFS['enterprise_welcome']==True; (g) @resend.dev signup → db.communications kind='enterprise_welcome' status='sent' with resend_id and user_id set; (h) @example.com → status='failed' with error containing 'example.com' (Resend sandbox gate), signup still returns 200; (i) template blowup monkeypatch signup still returns 200 (defensive route try/except).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.signup wraps the enterprise-signup dispatch in try/except with logger.exception — good observability improvement over iter52's silent pass. Consistent pattern with affiliate_welcome block.
email_templates.enterprise_welcome correctly uses escape() on name/enterprise_name/slug — XSS-safe.
_wrap(inner, brand_name=enterprise_name) automatically drops the 'smartbookssoftware.ai' platform reference in the footer for private-label whitelabelling — verified.
enterprises.ensure_personal_enterprise_for_pro is idempotent and correctly slugifies via _resolve_unique_slug with an appended -2/-3 suffix collision resolver.

Minor observability: the enterprise_signup branch calls ensure_personal_enterprise_for_pro(uid) but if that fails (e.g. slug collision after 50 iterations), the subsequent email dispatch will proceed with enterprise_slug=None which is handled gracefully — behavior is correct but the underlying failure is only logged via ent.slug None (no explicit warning). Non-blocker.

Enterprise signup correctly stamps branding.firm_name → auto-provisions personal enterprise via ensure_personal_enterprise_for_pro → dispatches enterprise_welcome email with private-label footer.
